title: protocols/MCP/* result
description: Result of a wrapped MCP message. It is the AcsResult of response-envelope.json with the rules that apply to protocols/MCP/*. Wrapped MCP adds no new result fields: the verdict is `decision`, the explanation is `reasoning`, and the audit chain head is `chain_hash`. A MODIFY uses `modifications` (Specification 6.3) and is limited to structured edits. `redactions[].path` is a JSON pointer into the wrapped payload (for example /mcp_params/arguments/body or /mcp_result/content/0/text). `parameter_overrides` replaces whole top-level members of `mcp_params` by name (for example `arguments`) and therefore applies to direction 'request' only. `modified_content` is not allowed, because replacing the payload with an opaque string would leave no valid MCP message to forward. A deployment that cannot apply MODIFY is handled per Specification 6.5.
